name: html-real-form-single-form-fallback
description: A real <form> with the same email + submit pairing as the div pseudo-form still emits exactly one html_form_fallback finding (tag form) and is never double-counted by the new div-based pseudo-form detection.

source_reference.notes: Guards against double emission: the <form> path owns the subtree, so the div-based pseudo-form detection must not also fire for the form or any wrapper around it.

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream primitive fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.
